findings.summary: The repository-coordinate regex accepts `owner/.` (and other dot-only final segments). This conflicts with the claimed owner/repository coordinate type and can be normalized differently by URL/API consumers than by provenance, enrollment, and key-registry lookups, undermining repository-bound authority.

GitHub App authentication specifies only RS256 and installation-token TTL; it does not require JWT issuer binding, issued-at/expiry claims, a short JWT lifetime, or clock-skew validation. The policy therefore leaves acceptance of replayable or overlong App JWTs unspecified.
